Converts a raster to a text file of XYZ triplets: a line for each cell, with the easting and the northing of its center and its value, separated by tabs.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Conversion<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Raster2Xyz`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to convert. |
| `doRemovenv` | boolean |  | `true` | If true, the cells with novalue are left out. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outFile` | output file |  | The output text file of the triplets. |
